environment.scope: Repository-only / migration-free / additive. Closes the dashboard full-coverage gap behind the authenticated production view: the equity curve read 'latest 9 of 12 accounts' and Open Trades read '6 accounts: live positions temporarily unavailable'. Read-only prod+bridge diagnosis (owner 29): the 3 equity-absent accounts are #49/#52/#56 (all GBP) — PortfolioEquityCurveView converts with FX.NullFxRateSource (USD-only), so every non-USD account's to_usd fails and it is dropped from every bucket; the 6 positions-unavailable accounts #48/#53/#54/#56/#57/#59 return HTTP 400 {ok:false,error:account_not_demo} (bridge demo-gate on LIVE terminals) which _fetch_mt5_open_positions mislabelled as the TRANSIENT bridge_unreachable because urlopen raises HTTPError on a 4xx and the 4xx body was never read. Fix: (1) read the 4xx body and classify it (account_not_demo -> structural positions_unsupported_live; else transient positions_refused); (2) point-in-time historical FX for the equity curve (per-bucket-date rate via fx_source.historical_rate_for_date, ONE bulk query, N+1-safe) so GBP accounts join; (3) independent bounded parallel positions reads so one slow account cannot starve the fleet and coverage scales past a fixed 12. The owner-scoped account universe (resolve_scope), is_active (execution gate only), Copy-Trading isolation, and the per-account reason taxonomy/frontend structural-vs-transient split are UNCHANGED. No production deploy, no migration, no host/MT5 mutation, no manual snapshot, no broker/credential action.

expected_results: Equity curve: with FX enabled for the caller, a non-USD (GBP) account converts at its POINT-IN-TIME per-bucket-date rate and JOINS the USD curve (the 3 absent GBP accounts #49/#52/#56 are no longer structurally excluded); when FX is not enabled the curve stays USD-only (byte-identical) and non-USD stays honestly PARTIAL. Never a single TODAY spot rate on history; never a fabricated rate (honest None/PARTIAL).

Live positions: a demo-gate returned as HTTP 400 {ok:false,error:account_not_demo} is classified STRUCTURAL (positions_unsupported_live), not the transient bridge_unreachable; an unparseable 4xx is the transient positions_refused (never a false 'reachable/0-open'); a real connection failure stays bridge_unreachable. The bridge error string is never echoed.

Independent bounded reads: one slow/hung account is named STALE (transient) within the overall budget and never starves the healthy accounts, which still contribute; coverage scales to an arbitrary fleet (not fixed at 12); results assembled in account order; a fetcher returning None stays 'unknown' (distinct from 'not collected').
No false zero: an unreadable account's open_pl_usd is None (never 0.0); the figure the card shows matches the coverage counts; structural vs transient are distinct.
Migration-free; secret scan clean; no is_active / Copy-Trading / broker / MT5 / credential / host change; account universe unchanged (resolve_scope owner + non-tombstoned).

Operational, not a code defect (reported truthfully): the bridge /mt5/positions demo-gate is INCONSISTENT across terminals — 6 LIVE terminals (#46/#49/#50/#51/#52/#58) serve positions while 6 (#48/#53/#54/#56/#57/#59) return account_not_demo. This PR makes the dashboard HONEST (structural vs transient) and removes head-of-line blocking; it does NOT lift the demo-gate or reconcile the per-terminal inconsistency (a separately-gated operational/host change).

Equity point-in-time conversion depends on fx_conversion_enabled_for(user) + an available within-staleness GBP->USD observation for each bucket's date; a date with no usable rate stays honestly PARTIAL (never fabricated). When FX is not enabled for the caller the curve is byte-identical to today (GBP still PARTIAL-excluded).

ThreadPoolExecutor query-count note: worker-thread DB queries are not counted by a main-thread assertNumQueries; the N+1 guards here target the equity historical-rate bulk loader (CaptureQueriesContext == 1) and the fake-fetcher open_positions path (no main-thread DB).
